Description: Hardcoded developer bypasses and insecure test credentials in API Gateway
Resolution_Notes: Hardcoded credentials removed; strict environment variable validation enforced

Description: Row Level Security (RLS) bypass via raw unbounded PostgreSQL queries
Resolution_Notes: Enforced tenant_id context binding on all pg pools; fail-closed database client implemented

Description: Unencrypted plain JSON database backups stored in world-readable directory
Resolution_Notes: Migrated to AES-256-GCM encrypted backup vault with HMAC header verification

Description: Rate limiter hook placed before auth starving hospital staff on shared NAT IP
Resolution_Notes: Moved rate limiter to preHandler (post-auth); authenticated staff receive 1000 req/min tenant quota

Description: Pharmacy dispensing did not enforce First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) order
Resolution_Notes: Added automated ORDER BY expiry_date ASC query in medicine allocation transaction

Description: Cashiers could self-authorize cash and online refunds without supervisor override
Resolution_Notes: Implemented 4-eyes Separation of Duties requiring FINANCE_SUPERVISOR role approval

Description: Lab technicians could digitally sign and release abnormal pathology reports
Resolution_Notes: Restricted report signing permission solely to registered PATHOLOGIST role

Description: 12-digit Aadhaar and national IDs emitted in plaintext debug logs
Resolution_Notes: Added regex redaction middleware in Pino logging pipeline; masks all but last 4 digits

Description: Razorpay webhook endpoint vulnerable to HMAC signature forgery and replay
Resolution_Notes: Implemented cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and processed_webhooks idempotency table

Description: Negative pricing and NaN values allowed in commercial subscription checkout
Resolution_Notes: Strict Joi/Zod numeric bounds validation implemented on all billing endpoints

Description: Tampered HMAC license tokens allowed unauthorized enterprise feature activation
Resolution_Notes: Cryptographic Ed25519/HMAC signature verification with automated fallback to LOCKED state

Description: FHIR R4 DiagnosticReport missing mandatory LOINC coding attributes
Resolution_Notes: Mapped all internal test codes to standard international LOINC ontology

Description: Temporary test backups left unpurged in repository root causing disk bloat
Resolution_Notes: Automated retention pruning job purges temporary test artifacts; freed 292 MB space

Description: Multi-analyte pathology panels overflowing single page printed report
Resolution_Notes: Engineered compact dynamic CSS/PDF layout fitting standard CBC/LFT panels on 1 page

Description: Orthanc DICOM C-STORE connection timeout under high network latency
Resolution_Notes: Implemented exponential backoff retry handler with 3 attempts on DICOM socket

Description: Zero-rated healthcare consultations incorrectly assessed for GST
Resolution_Notes: Tagged clinical consults with SAC 999312 (0% exempt) and pharma with HSN 3004

Description: Database connection pool exhaustion under sudden 100-user spike
Resolution_Notes: Tuned pg.Pool max connections to 35 with connection queue timeout of 5000 ms

Description: Prescription dosage frequency selector lacked standard medical abbreviations
Resolution_Notes: Added BID
column14: STAT standard nomenclature to doctor UI

Description: Thermal receipt printer ESC/POS baud rate mismatch on hardware bridge
Resolution_Notes: Defaulted Local Hardware Agent serial bridge to 9600/115200 auto-negotiation

Description: Free trial expiration date calculated using local client timezone
Resolution_Notes: Normalized all license calculation logic to UTC ISO timestamps in database

Description: Cross-tenant subscription upgrade vulnerability in partner admin portal
Resolution_Notes: RLS tenant boundary enforced on subscription order creation; cross-tenant updates rejected

Description: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers on partner frontend app
Resolution_Notes: Configured strict Helmet CSP directives restricting script-src and object-src

Description: Duplicate vitals entry possible if nurse clicks submit multiple times
Resolution_Notes: Debounced UI submit button and added idempotency constraint on patient_vitals

Description: Cash drawer discrepancy calculation failed to alert supervisor on shortfall
Resolution_Notes: Added automated notification trigger when shift variance exceeds ₹50.00

Description: Patient consent revocation did not instantly unbind ABDM health artifacts
Resolution_Notes: Added synchronous hook updating consent_status to REVOKED and invalidating tokens

Description: Health probe readiness check returned 200 before DB pool was fully warmed
Resolution_Notes: Added pgPool.query('SELECT 1') validation before returning HTTP 200 on /health/readiness

Description: Missing automated log rotation on local API Gateway Winston/Pino logs
Resolution_Notes: Integrated pino-roll with daily rotation and 14-day retention cap

Description: SAC backward GST calculation had 1-paisa rounding divergence on odd amounts
Resolution_Notes: Implemented IEEE-754 banker's rounding to 2 decimal places matching Indian GST portal

Description: Missing Devanagari font glyphs in PDF invoice header under headless Linux
Resolution_Notes: Embedded Noto Sans Devanagari font base64 into PDF vector rendering pipeline

Description: Partner dashboard sidebar collapsed state did not persist across browser reload
Resolution_Notes: Persisted sidebar collapse state in localStorage
